about: Pictures and clips for the README, captured on the macOS and Windows test machines, a hosted Linux runner and the phone page in Chromium: platform, feature, captions and how each was made. "agent": "simulated" marks a picture whose agent sessions are small local programs (scripts/e2e/demo_agents.py) or synthetic transcripts, never a real agent or a model call; their model shows as "simulated". Windows pictures without a prefix replace the earlier ones of the same name; workspace, claude, codex, omp, chat, chatgpt, powershell, light, vietnamese and agents are kept from the owner's own sign-ins and installed agents.
